structured.answer: Open an account at פסגות and buy ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D), the pair the page marks "הזול". It says I'd end up with about 86,492 ₪ after 10 years, but that's with its preset numbers (10,000 now + 500 a month, 70,000 put in), not my 30,000.

Not sure if 0 ₪ means free or zero difference from the cheapest

findings.what: The big result 86,492 ₪ is for preset amounts (10,000 + 500/month), easy to take it as 'my' number
Lots of minus numbers in red and a 'בין ... ל ...' range make every non-recommended option look scary
'1 ₪ יותר / 58 ₪ פחות / 14 ₪ יותר' — unclear what is being compared
Too many colored tag chips per fund with jargon I don't understand
'0 ₪' for the cheapest account is ambiguous (free? or zero difference?)
No obvious 'what to do now' step
